scenario.title: The user saves the agent's composer answer into a space (and, as a twin, onto a dashboard)
scenario.prompt: Chart payments of at least 20 by method.
expect: the answer shows a composer chart artifact with a Save action
Save into Emulator scenarios creates a space-owned chart; its page opens and draws
twin run: Save onto Emulator dashboard adds a tile as before
readBack: composer_charts row owned by the chosen space (or dashboard)

queries.title: Payments by method
queries.description: Total payment amount per payment method.
queries.sql: SELECT payment_method, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM postgres.jaffle.payments WHERE amount >= 20 GROUP BY 1

reply.text: Here are payments of at least 20 by method.
